title: Complete and verify safe Node runtime floors for local projects
acceptance: Unsupported Node releases fail before command dispatch and supported fixed releases keep normal CLI behavior.
Focused requirement supersede help exposes every runtime-required input with a runnable example.
Full suites pass on Node 18.20.3, Node 20.12.0, and Node 24 with no residual worker processes.
Static checks, doctor, enterprise benchmark, packaging, distributed-build verification, and local-project replay remain green.
The validated patch reaches origin/main without force and the official local installation matches source version, commit, and fingerprint.
